checks.item: Item 1: QMSum adapter grounded 0.064 is not a citation/mapping defect
checks.evidence: Read saved QMSum rows (T6.2-prep/results/partial/e5/v3-fa1255c50172-sc) against the dev conversations: adapter cited 92 turn ids, all exist; quote and speaker match the turn for 92/92; 91/92 are in the retrieved set. Train and test prompt format use the same SYSTEM and user_prompt. Training QMSum conversations are all in the train split (0 in dev or test). The low rate is 73/78 long summary-style statements unsupported by the single (200-char) quote cited. That is real hallucination, and it falls on the same judge input as the prompted side.

The first raw reply itself has status abstained and no findings in 103/148 scenario rows, so this is not a post-hoc demotion by the harness. Raw replies are valid JSON. Whether the schema constraint nudges the model toward 'abstained' cannot be tested without a GPU; the unconstrained run is not informative because the model never used the status vocabulary. Left as a note.

Both sides go through RecordingHF with the same schema-constrained decoding, REPLY_TOKENS 800, DEADLINE_S 300, the same saved retrieval selection. They differ only in prompt format (v3 vs training format), which is the intended comparison. The adapter's trained 'recent' definition differs (3 turns before the gold turn), but the adapter cites the newest-3 turns in 127 of 132 scenario rows, so this does not block it.

e5-qmsum-100 ids: 0 in qmsum train or test splits, all in dev conversations (ids start 'qmsum-test-N' only because of the source file name). Training example conversations (cards/*.jsonl): 0 in dev or test of qmsum; scenarios-train ids are not in scenarios dev or test. No datasets/**/test* read beyond ids.

no legacy/ files, no secrets matched; single.py change adds overridable reply_tokens, call_timeout_s and _messages with defaults unchanged (700, 10 s); the only removals in tests/test_cards_data.py are an import and the old 7.0 GB assertion, matching the new 5.5 GB limit

notes: (1) QMSum rows are in git-ignored files, now only in the T6.2-prep worktree (results/partial/e5), not the main folder; the QMSum figures can't be recomputed by check_run, as the record states. (2) QMSum prompted grounded 0.632 rests on 19 claims from 7 answered cases (91 of 100 abstained), so the 0.064 vs 0.632 comparison is confounded by what each side chose to answer; the claim counts are in the record. (3) Prompted QMSum has 8 unparseable first replies and p95 latency 201 s, which hints at truncation at 800 tokens or the deadline in a few cases; this is not isolated. (4) The adapter says 'answered' even on insufficient cases (abstain_when_insufficient 0.44 on recall). (5) Judge is Haiku, which failed calibration; this is stated in the record, and no person reviewed the judgements, so the figures are provisional. (6) The training set (212) is under the 300 minimum; the record flags under_minimum. (7) Training format puts 'recent' before the gold turn while test puts it at the newest 3 retrieved: a small undocumented train/test mismatch.
